title: Broiled Garlic Parmesan Chicken Skewers
description: Chicken breast skewers seasoned with garlic, onion, and paprika, broiled like souvlaki, then finished with a garlic parmesan butter glaze. Uses half the butter and twice the parmesan of the original, for about 53 g protein and 12 g fat per skewer.
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts (about 10 oz / 280 g each, 2.5 lb / 1134 g total), cut into 1.25-inch cubes
1 tbsp Kinder's Buttery Garlic & Herb seasoning (or 1 tsp dried Italian seasoning)
1 tsp salt (cut to 1/2 tsp if using Kinder's)
1/4 cup (20 g) finely grated parmesan, divided
instructions: If using wooden skewers, soak 5 skewers in water for 30 minutes. Move an oven rack about 6 inches below the broiler. Line a sheet pan with foil, set a wire rack on top, and mist the rack with canola cooking spray.

In a large bowl, toss 2.5 lb (1134 g) cubed chicken breast with 1 tbsp Kinder's Buttery Garlic & Herb seasoning (or 1 tsp dried Italian seasoning), 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp salt (1/2 tsp if using Kinder's), and 1/2 tsp black pepper until evenly coated.
Thread the chicken onto 5 skewers, leaving a little space between pieces so they brown rather than steam. Lay them on the rack and give them a light mist of canola cooking spray.
Preheat the broiler on high for 5 minutes. Broil the skewers 6–7 minutes until browned on top, then flip and broil another 5–6 minutes.

While the chicken broils, microwave 2 tbsp (28 g) butter in a small bowl for 20–30 seconds until melted. Whisk in 1 tbsp (15 g) garlic paste until smooth, then stir in 2 tbsp chopped parsley and half of the 1/4 cup (20 g) grated parmesan, about 2 tbsp (10 g).

Check that the thickest piece reads 160°F (71°C). Brush half of the garlic parmesan butter over the skewers and sprinkle with the remaining 2 tbsp (10 g) parmesan. Broil 1–2 minutes, watching closely, until the cheese bubbles and starts to brown. Pull them before the garlic darkens.
Rest 3 minutes (the chicken will carry over to 165°F / 74°C). Brush with the remaining garlic parmesan butter and serve.
notes: Each skewer is about 8 oz of raw chicken, a full dinner portion on its own. Split 3 breasts across 5 skewers for smaller appetites. Many garlic pastes are pre-salted, so taste the butter glaze before adding extra salt anywhere. Garlic paste browns faster than minced garlic, so watch the final broil closely. Broiler strength varies, so trust your souvlaki timing and use a thermometer. With the butternut sage soup, the full meal comes to about 555 kcal, 64 g protein, and 17 g fat. Grate the parmesan on a Microplane so 20 g covers everything.
